source_name: ЗЕЛС — Заедница на единиците на локалната самоуправа
why_relevant: Umbrella body of all MK municipalities; runs a unit supporting municipal electronic services and software, and co-organises with УЈП the rollout of е-фактура to municipalities and ЈКП. It is the best single pointer to the full municipal actor list and to sector-wide digitisation programmes that precede local tenders.

source_name: Управа за јавни приходи (УЈП) — уплатни сметки and e-invoice programme
why_relevant: Owns the уплатни сметки (payment account) taxonomy through which municipal and utility public revenues are settled, and co-drives е-фактура adoption by municipalities and ЈКП with ЗЕЛС. Defines the rails that any municipal collection tender must integrate with; also publishes its own procurement procedure documents.

source_name: Municipal legacy/archive procurement pages (e.g. Општина Велес архива)
why_relevant: Demonstrates the common pattern outside Skopje: smaller municipalities keep their own (often archived, often stale) tender pages in parallel with ЕСЈН. Valuable for historical award records that have aged out of the national portal's front-end.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA)
why_relevant: Single entry point for Commission-managed calls and procurements, including IPA III and digital-transition instruments that reach MK institutions. Organisation pages also expose MK participating entities (e.g. registered MK public bodies), revealing which institutions receive EU-funded contracts.

source_name: EEAS Tenders — Delegation of the EU to North Macedonia
why_relevant: The EU Delegation in Skopje is itself a contracting authority for external-action service contracts in MK; its tender pages (also published in Macedonian) carry notices below TED thresholds that never appear elsewhere.

source_name: EBRD corporate procurement / SMART by GEP
why_relevant: Covers consultancy assignments contracted by EBRD itself (not the client) — the vehicle for policy/advisory work on MK payments and financial infrastructure. Distinct pipeline from ECEPP.

source_name: World Bank — Contract Awards in Investment Project Financing, North Macedonia
why_relevant: Structured, downloadable dataset of awarded contracts under WB-financed MK projects — supplier name, country, amount, method. Directly answers 'who won donor-funded work' for PFM/financial-sector projects.

source_name: World Bank Documents & Reports — MK procurement plans and project documents (STEP-derived)
why_relevant: Procurement plans for MK operations (e.g. P176366 'Building Effective, Transparent and Accountable PFM Institutions', implemented by the Ministry of Finance) list forthcoming packages, methods, and estimated values before any notice is published — a forward-looking pipeline signal for banking/PFM IT.

source_name: World Bank corporate procurement — administrative business opportunities (RFX)
why_relevant: Publishes WB's own consultancy RFXs, including an explicitly payments-related MK assignment ('Electronic Payments in North Macedonia', RFX 2007835) run with the National Bank of North Macedonia. Reveals both the analytical agenda and the advisory firms engaged.

source_name: CFCD — Central Financing and Contracting Department, MK Ministry of Finance (Сектор за централно финансирање и склучување договори)
why_relevant: The single national contracting authority for IPA under indirect management: it runs the tender procedures, signs the contracts and executes payments for EU-funded services, supplies, works, grants and twinning in MK. Its TENDERS and Contracted Projects pages are the authoritative MK-side record of donor-funded awards, including finance-ministry digitalisation packages.

source_name: Ministry of Finance MK — public procurement notices and contracts page (Огласи и договори за јавни набавки)
why_relevant: The ministry is the borrower/beneficiary for WB PFM and IPA digitalisation operations; its own notices page and its IT & Digitalisation sector page (Сектор за ИТ технологија и дигитализација) show where donor money lands in treasury/payment systems.

source_name: Secretariat for European Affairs (СЕП) — Јавни повици / Друга странска помош
why_relevant: National IPA coordination body; publishes public calls and maintains an inventory of 'other foreign assistance' (non-EU donors) and the national WBIF page. Best MK-language pointer to which donors are financing what, before procurement appears anywhere.

source_name: Ministry of European Affairs MK (МЕП) — ИПА проекти
why_relevant: Successor/parallel body to SEP publishing the IPA project inventory; provides the official MK-language names of IPA operations that later surface as CFCD tenders. Useful for glossary building and for catching renamed institutions.

source_name: EIB — calls for technical assistance / procurement
why_relevant: EIB is a WBIF pillar and runs the IPF technical-assistance framework contracts covering Digital Economy for the Western Balkans including MK; the calls carry lot descriptions and later award information.

source_name: UNDP Procurement Notices portal
why_relevant: UNDP MK country office procures digital-governance and financial-inclusion consultancies and systems; notices carry TORs that describe intended payment/digitalisation architecture and later reveal awarded suppliers.

source_name: UNGM — United Nations Global Marketplace
why_relevant: Aggregates tender notices across 40+ UN organisations (UNDP, UNICEF, IOM, UNOPS), the widest single net for UN-funded procurement touching MK digital-payment and financial-inclusion work.

source_name: KfW-financed programme procurement in MK (incl. Regional Challenge Fund procurement page)
source_subtype: donor-financed fund management unit procurement page
why_relevant: Concrete evidence that KfW-financed facilities publish country-specific calls for tender and notifications of award under KfW procurement guidelines, outside the national portal. Establishes the KfW channel and its notice format even though the observed lots were non-financial.

source_name: DevelopmentAid — donor tender aggregator
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that normalises EC, KfW, EBRD, WB and UN notices per country and sector, including MK. Valuable for retrospective discovery and for catching notices whose primary source is hard to crawl; not authoritative, so treat as a lead generator.

source_name: OpenTender / OCP Data Registry — EU + Western Balkans procurement open data
why_relevant: Republishes TED and national procurement data in OCDS form across 35 jurisdictions including North Macedonia, enabling cross-jurisdiction supplier and CPV analysis that the native portals do not support.

source_name: World Bank ECA brief — Advancing the Modernization and Integration of Payment Systems in the Western Balkans
why_relevant: Names the donor-funded payments workstream (SEPA alignment, instant payments) that generates the consultancies and system procurements this cell tracks; a reliable early indicator of forthcoming TA and tenders involving the National Bank of North Macedonia.

source_name: Развојна банка на Северна Македонија (MBDP) — Јавни набавки
why_relevant: The state-owned Development Bank is the ONE bank in this cell that is a contracting authority under the Law on Public Procurement, so its buying (IT, cards, security, facilities) is disclosed as formal tenders on its own site and on e-nabavki. It is the closest available proxy for what a MK bank actually buys and at what price level.

source_name: MBDP — Јавни огласи / Известување за јавноста
why_relevant: Second publication channel of the same bank; some calls for offers, expressions of interest and consultant selections appear here rather than in the formal Јавни набавки register.

source_name: MBDP — Извештаи на банката / Информации од јавен карактер
why_relevant: Annual and periodic reports of the only state-owned bank in the cell, plus a Freedom-of-Information (информации од јавен карактер) channel that can be used to request contract-level detail no private bank would disclose.
